queue.title: Fmr. LVMH Exec. Brown on Estée Comeback, Consumer Trends
queue.resumo: Pauline Brown, former chairman of LVMH North America, discussed evolving trends in the luxury market. She highlighted that while traditional luxury spending correlates with strong economic indicators like housing and low unemployment, today's consumers are more discerning. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Sally Bakewell on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
